title: Model artifact security
intro: Review revision-bound results, file evidence and download policies.
incompleteHighRisk: High-risk findings block downloads. Other checks did not finish: inspect the evidence, quarantine and replace the artifact, then rescan. Allowing scan failures does not override known high risk.
cancelHint: This revision remains unavailable after cancellation. Rescan to resume processing.
pickleNotApplicable: No Pickle metadata identified by the bounded format checks
rawTensorStorage: PyTorch tensor byte storage (included in the container's ClamAV scan)
mlConstructionReview: Expected ML reconstruction calls: review runtime dependencies and provenance
reportIncomplete: Revision inspection did not complete. Open file evidence for the specific reason; if there are no file results, check revision availability and scanner configuration.

errors.file_size_limit: File exceeds the configured size limit. Split the artifact into supported shards before rescanning.
errors.pickle_metadata_limit: Pickle metadata exceeds the static-analysis limit (up to 8 MiB). Large weight containers have a separate file limit.
errors.archive_expansion_limit: Expanded archive content exceeds the scan budget.
errors.archive_member_limit: Archive contains too many members for this scan configuration.
errors.archive_ratio_limit: Archive compression ratio exceeds the scan budget.
errors.encrypted_archive: Encrypted content cannot be fully inspected. Provide an unencrypted artifact.
errors.unsupported_serialization: Serialization format is unsupported or damaged; inspection did not complete.
errors.static_analysis_incomplete: Pickle static analysis did not complete. Check format, complexity and analyzer support.
errors.scanner_timeout: Scanner exceeded its time budget. Check resources and rescan.
errors.scanner_busy: Scanner is processing another artifact. Retry after it finishes.
errors.scanner_limit_exceeded: ClamAV reached an inspection limit. The file was not marked clean.
errors.scanner_unavailable: Scanner is unavailable. Check its service and signature database.
errors.truncated_request: Scanner did not receive the complete artifact.
errors.scan_budget_exceeded: Task was cancelled or exceeded its processing budget.
errors.artifact_unavailable: Artifact content could not be read.
errors.read_failed_or_oversized: Artifact could not be fully read or exceeded its size limit.
errors.artifact_integrity_mismatch: Artifact size or digest differs from immutable repository metadata.
errors.scanner_ruleset_changed: Scanner rules changed during inspection. Run a new scan.
errors.scanner_protocol_invalid: Scanner returned an invalid result. Inspection did not complete.
errors.scanner_content_mismatch: Scanner digest differs from the repository content. Check transport integrity.
errors.cache_unavailable: Scan result cache is unavailable. Check database connectivity.
errors.cache_persistence_failed: Scan results could not be persisted. Recover the database before rescanning.
errors.scanner_incomplete: Inspection did not complete. Check scanner logs and rescan after recovery.

noFindings: Completed checks matched no risk rules.
incompleteFindings: No rule matches are available in this result. Check its status and error details.
historyHint: This page shows the selected revision. Git repository downloads also check history and remain blocked while dangerous history is present.
policyHint: Applies to all models in this project. Incomplete or failed scans are blocked by default. High-risk matches always block downloads.
unavailable: Security unavailable: check revision, permissions and scanner configuration

recommendations.quarantine_and_replace: Quarantine this revision and inspect matched files. Replace or remove the artifact, then rescan.
recommendations.manual_review: Review the matched rules and file origin before making a distribution decision under project policy.
recommendations.distribute_by_policy: Checks completed. Distribute under project policy and reevaluate after content or rule changes.
recommendations.repair_and_rescan: Inspect the failure and scanner availability, then rescan after recovery.

auditDecisions.object_not_bound_to_scanned_revision_den: Object not bound to scanned revision: denied
auditDecisions.object_not_bound_to_dataset_revision_den: Object not bound to dataset revision: denied
